card1Content: Every plan we design is carefully crafted to leverage your strengths, and we work with you to understand your needs, ensuring you are always one step ahead on your path to achieving your goals.

zalonDescription: Zalon is an innovative web solution designed for the beauty and wellness sector. This platform replaces traditional paper schedules, automating shift management and keeping your business always available.
famileDescription: Famil-E is a web platform designed to simplify family meal planning. This solution allows users to organize their weekly menus, control food costs, and have everything delivered directly to their home.
zalonDesignDescription: Zalon Design is a web platform dedicated to selling Instagram templates to empower businesses in the beauty and wellness sector. The platform offers customizable image templates that users can adapt and use on their own Instagram accounts.
famileBackofficeDescription: Business-to-business management platform dedicated to crucial areas in the operations of small and medium-sized enterprises that are part of Famil-e's shopper network. This platform serves as a comprehensive back-office for efficient order management, addressing critical aspects such as logistics, finance, and other key operational processes.
summaryText: We aspire to be allies in the deployment of ideas, the expansion of creativity, and the realization of ambitious concepts into tangible projects. We work hard to orchestrate the different parts involved in each project, aiming to provide ingenious solutions that ultimately benefit society.
weAreDevs: We are dev first, we care about you.
weAreDevsDescription: We understand that the true protagonists of technology are the developers. We are a passionate team of creators and dreamers, and we are looking for exceptional people like you to join our team.
